sections.description: Database Agency is designed with a structured layout that supports organised content presentation and flexible website management. The theme includes configurable homepage sections for featured content, service details, testimonials, team profiles, and contact information. Built-in customization settings allow adjustments to colours, typography, navigation menus, widgets, headers, and footers through the Customizer. Logo uploads, image galleries, and banner sections can be managed without editing the core files, helping maintain a consistent website structure. The theme supports the block editor and integrates with commonly used page-building tools for creating custom page layouts. It is compatible with standard plugins for contact forms, search engine optimisation, caching, and security, allowing additional functionality while maintaining compatibility with current platform updates. Translation-ready files support multilingual websites, and the code follows current development standards for easier maintenance. Layout spacing, fonts, widget areas, and content sections can be customised using available settings, providing flexibility while preserving an organised appearance. Database Agency also includes configurable navigation, footer options, and visual controls that simplify content management and support consistent presentation across different pages.
